text.description_html:
LCN 2030 Series Door Closer Track

This is the new style replacement track for LCN 2030 Series (LCN Pacer) concealed door closer. Track does not have the eight (8) small screw holes that were used for the old style Hold Open Clip and/or Stop Cushion

Also available other LCN Door Closer Parts

Aluminum concealed Track. Non-handed for use with or with out Hold Open Clip and/or Stop Cushion.

Total track length is 22-1/2". Package includes necessary track mounting screw hardware.

*Sold Individually
